title: Purchasing with Purpose / Banner Pool 08: Grant-Funded Contractual Services — eTraining Module
content:
Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects

Hello Morgan State University Faculty & Staff, In this module, we will review key processes for procurement of goods and services on sponsored projects at Morgan State University. Topics include purchasing supplies with a University purchasing card, the requisition process in Banner, procurement of services, invoice processing through Accounts Payable, and more. Please note that the processes detailed in this module are specific to grant-funded activities. Some of the information may also be relevant to state-funded actions; however, policy and procedural differences may apply. We strive to continuously review these lessons to provide up-to-date guidance on Morgan’s sponsored project processes. For questions related to the activities covered in this module that are not addressed in the module content, please contact the ORA Training and Communications Coordinator: Mr. Ryan Mobley, CRA, CFRA, CPRA Email: ryan.mobley@morgan.edu Phone: 443-885-4771 Thank you, ORA Training Team

Self-paced ORA eTraining module. Source: https://share.articulate.com/Oj9sl7O574NyfS_WK9btG

This module has 15 lessons, each a separate knowledge base entry:
1. Uniform Guidance: Subpart E
2. Procurement Playbook (Research Essentials)
3. Tax Exempt Purchasing
4. Requisition Entry Prep
5. How To: Requisition Entry in Banner
6. Processing Invoices for Payment
7. MSU: Subawards vs. Subcontracts
8. MSU Working Fund
9. Catering & Events
10. Purchasing Supplies on Sponsored Awards
11. P-Card Use: Quick Guide
12. Equipment: Procurement Best Practices
13. Non-Travel Reimbursement
14. Procurement on Sponsored Awards Knowledge Review
15. Message from ORA
